Cc: AWS Partner Success <aws-ps@amazon.com>, procurement@acmecloud.com
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CPPO entitlements: mapping matrix + go-live checklist

Team — looping you all in on the CPPO entitlement mapping work for Acme Cloud. AWS PS joined the initial intake and confirmed they expect the reseller/merchant split to be set using the vendor-supplied SKU mapping rather than a custom SKU. Acme's procurement asked for a clean entitlement matrix we can use when creating the Channel Private Offer.

Attached: CPPO_Entitlement_Matrix.xlsx (draft) — includes proposed SKU list, quantities, term, and billing entity options. High-level asks:
- Confirm the correct Redwood SKU names to present in the CPPO (Ben).
- Confirm whether we should route billing to Acme's merchant account or to Redwood with reseller split (Laura).
- Create a short go-live checklist for the reseller activation (Tessa).

I'll schedule a 30-min alignment call for Tue morning unless folks prefer a different slot. Goal is to hand off a finalized entitlement matrix to AWS by EOD Wed so they can lift the CPPO draft.

Thanks,
Priyom
--
Priyom Das
Director, Channel Partnerships
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: CPPO_Entitlement_Matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CPPO entitlements: mapping matrix + go-live checklist

Priyom — thanks, good starter. I reviewed the matrix and left inline notes in column F about SKU aliases we need to normalize to our internal catalog. Two quick clarifications:
1) For the large inference pool SKU, Acme requested a pre-committed quantity but we typically recommend a burstable approach for first 3 months to avoid overcommit. I'll flag recommended commit bands in the sheet.
2) We should include the quantization profile (int8 vs bf16) as a note per SKU so the CPPO reflects expected unit pricing.

I can jump on Tue 9:30am PT. If Laura wants billing routed via Redwood (we have a reseller split template), we should surface margin band and invoice flow.

Ben
--
Ben Carter
Head of Marketplaces
Redwood Inference

From: procurement@acmecloud.com <procurement@acmecloud.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: AWS Partner Success <aws-ps@amazon.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CPPO entitlements: mapping matrix + go-live checklist

Thanks for the matrix. A few items from Acme procurement:
- We will need the merchant-of-record option documented; our finance team prefers marketplace billing to our vendor (Redwood) on Year 1 PO but is open to reviewing reseller-split models if there's a clear reconciliation flow.
- Please confirm the legal entity and tax ID that will appear on invoices under both models.
- For the CPPO SKUs, can you provide the unit definitions (tokens/min, concurrency) so we can size the entitlement correctly?

If possible, share a one-page 'billing choices' summary that lays out pros/cons for marketplace vs vendor billing. We will bring in finance for a call Wed if needed.

Regards,
Maria Alvarez
Director, Procurement — Acme Cloud
[Attachment: Acme_PO_stub.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: procurement@acmecloud.com <procurement@acmecloud.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: AWS Partner Success <aws-ps@amazon.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CPPO entitlements: mapping matrix + go-live checklist

Maria — thanks, and good questions. Quick answers and next steps below.

1) Merchant-of-record vs reseller-split (one-pager): attaching a short summary in the sheet now under tab 'BillingSummary'. In short:
   - Marketplace billing to Acme (merchant-of-record = Acme) => fastest procurement for them, reduces reconciliation overhead on Redwood but requires Acme to be listed as the buyer in AWS.
   - Vendor billing (Redwood invoice) with reseller split => allows Redwood to appear on invoices while Acme uses reseller credits; introduces an additional settlement step but keeps Redwood's billing flows consistent.

2) Legal entity / tax ID: Laura, can you confirm Redwood's entity to populate the CPPO? If we go marketplace billing we'll need the merchant legal name for the CPPO form.

3) Unit definitions: Ben will add token/concurrency guidance inline; I also included an example entitlement for a 6-month pilot (see example rows).

Proposed immediate plan (Mutual Action Plan):
- Tue 9:30am PT: 30-min alignment call (Ben, Laura, Tessa, Maria + AWS PS).
- Tue EOD: finalize entitlement matrix and billing summary.
- Wed AM: AWS to initiate CPPO draft.
- Thu: Acme legal review, then DocuSign.

If this works, I will send the calendar invite.

Best,
Priyom

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
